question:
Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. V has the exam on Wednesday. Only one person has the exam after T. P has the exam immediately after R, but not on Tuesday. S has the exam immediately before U.

How many people have exams between P and Q?
solution:
**Given :** Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) V has the exam on Wednesday.

2) Only one person has the exam after T.
